pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Disclosure Navigation: a navigation landmark with lists of links, groups as disclosure buttons (aria-expanded + aria-controls), and aria-current="page" on the active item. Drawer mode uses the Drawer (modal <dialog>) pattern; the rail uses Tooltip as the accessible name.

aria.value: Present while the group is collapsed
true (the element has no href and is not focusable)

aria.element: each enabled item, group, and the toggle (icon rail only)
aria.value: id of its tooltip, whose text is the label
id of the drawer title (the `label` option)
rtl when direction is 'rtl'; absent otherwise

keyboard.action: Moves between enabled items, group buttons, and the collapse toggle (native tab order). Disabled items and items inside collapsed groups are skipped.
Emits cancelable aui-navigate; unless prevented, the item becomes active (aui-change), the drawer closes in drawer mode, and the link navigates natively.
Same as a link, without native navigation.
Expands or collapses the group in place (focus stays) and emits aui-expanded-change.
Switches between the full sidebar and the icon rail and emits aui-collapsed-change.
Closes the drawer and restores focus (Drawer behavior; follows the drawer closeOnEscape configuration).

focus: Every enabled item and group button is a Tab stop. Toggling a group, activating an item, and update() keep focus on the same item id. In drawer mode, open() moves focus into the modal drawer and close() returns it to the element focused before opening (usually the application's menu button).
notes: The active item is conveyed by aria-current="page", a selected background, and semibold weight, not color alone.
In the icon rail, labels stay in the DOM (visually hidden) and each control is also labelled by its tooltip, so names do not change when the sidebar collapses.
Collapsed groups hide their lists with the hidden attribute, removing them from the accessibility tree and the tab order.
Drawer mode inherits Drawer's modal behavior: inert background, focus containment, and focus restoration.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
Disabled items are not focusable and have no rail tooltip; they are reachable only in a screen reader's browse mode.
No arrow-key navigation (optional in the Disclosure Navigation pattern); long sidebars take many Tab presses.
